root.name: クラトス・ディフェンス

relations.text: 2022年に、Blue Halo(AeroVironmentが買収)から約1.6億ドルの契約獲得の可能性を得た
relations.text_en: In 2022, received an approximate $160 million potential contract award from Blue Halo (acquired by AeroVironment)

source.label: Kratos Defense 10-K
source.quote: Related to certain of these investments, in 2022, we received an approximate $160 million potential contract award from Blue Halo (acquired by AeroVironment) and a significant contract award from Intelsat (acquired by SES) as a result of Kratos OpenSpace™ products and technology.
source.note: 買収後のBlue Halo経由の記載です。
source.note_en: Refers to Blue Halo, which AeroVironment later acquired.

source.quote: arc jet and coupled fiber laser facility for hypersonic materials evaluations, known internally as Project Helios, and a recent announcement that Kratos’ teammate Northrop Grumman was competitively awarded the U.S.

relations.text: AirbusとKratosは、2029年までに戦闘対応の無人僚機CCAを納入する計画で順調に進んでいる
relations.text_en: Airbus and Kratos are on track to deliver a combat-ready uncrewed Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) by 2029

source.label: KTOS / Airbus — official relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.label_en: KTOS / Airbus — official relationship source; checked October 17, 2026
source.quote: This key milestone confirms that Airbus and Kratos are on track to deliver a combat-ready uncrewed Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) by 2029, addressing the operational requirements of the German and other European Armed Forces.

relations.text: クラトス・ディフェンスの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in Kratos’s annual report

source.label: Kratos Defense 10-K
source.quote: Tier two competitors include smaller government contractors such as Mercury Systems, Qinetiq, Cobham, CACI, Peraton, Linquest (now owned by KBR), Viasat and AAR Corp.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
